title: Square-zero affine base-change tests detect module tensor exactness
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], C a cochain complex of quasi-coherent O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] [pqf-def-coherent], and a an integer. Put A = Gamma(S,O_S) and let P be the complex obtained by applying the global-sections evaluation functor termwise. If H^a(g*C) is zero for every scheme map g:S′ -> S [def-pc-base-change], then for every A-module N the ordinary module tensor complex P tensor_A N is exact in degree a. No flatness, boundedness or finite-presentation hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01IB (affine equivalence), Tag 01I9 (affine pullback); steps 1--2 of lem-pc-affine-universally-exact-opcycles-flat, square-zero test.

proof.text: Set A=Gamma(S,top), P=Gamma(C,top), and B=TrivSqZeroExt A N, the explicit square-zero algebra. The A-linear maps j:N->B, x|->(0,x), and p:B->N, (a,x)|->x, satisfy j followed by p=id. TensoringRight sends them to natural transformations; mapHomologicalComplex sends their composite to the identity, giving a retraction of P tensor N from P tensor B.

Apply affine_tensor_pullback_homology_comparison to B. The universal hypothesis gives zero homology after pullback along Spec B -> Spec A -> S. Global sections and restriction of scalars are additive, hence carry a zero object to a zero object. Transport zero through the comparison to get zero homology for P tensor B.

Apply homologyFunctor to the retraction. Its composite is the identity of H^a(P tensor N), while its inclusion is zero because its target H^a(P tensor B) is zero. Thus this identity is zero. IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero and HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology give ExactAt a.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_universal_tensor_exact (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hexact : ∀ {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S),
      IsZero ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology a))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) :
    (((tensorRight N).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (.op ⊤) :
        S.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj C)).ExactAt a
